questions.stem: What was the first artificial satellite launched into space, and in what year?
questions.explanation: Sputnik 1, launched by the Soviet Union in 1957, was the first artificial satellite to be placed into Earth's orbit. This event marked the beginning of the space age and the space race between the USA and the Soviet Union.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a major challenge of human spaceflight?

options.text: Too much oxygen in the spacecraft
Exposure to radiation and the effects of microgravity on the body
The inability to communicate with Earth

questions.explanation: Major challenges of human spaceflight include exposure to cosmic radiation (which increases cancer risk) and the effects of microgravity, such as muscle atrophy and bone density loss. Astronauts must exercise regularly and spacecraft must provide radiation shielding.
